resources.string: Start a separate workspace, or use your recovery key to restore notes you have uploaded.
Create new workspace
Restore from a local folder or backup
Back to settings
Restore from server
Enter your server address and recovery key to restore the latest uploaded notes. Server mode is enabled automatically. No local folder selection is needed.
Server recovery copy
Automatically upload an encrypted copy of your notes, note types, properties and attachments for recovery on a new device.
Keep an encrypted copy that you can restore on a new device with your recovery key.
Manage server copy
Server address
Use the HTTPS address of your Tagloom server.
Server registration code
Provided by your server administrator for first registration. Leave blank if a server copy already exists; your recovery key can reconnect it.
Upload recovery copy
Update copy now
Last confirmed copy: %1$s
Your master key has changed. Enter the new recovery key to update your server copy. Until then, the previous copy still uses the old key.
Recovery copy uploaded. It is ready to restore on another device.
Try again
Enter a valid HTTPS server address without credentials or query parameters.
The server could not authorize this request. Check the server address and recovery key or registration code.
This recovery key could not unlock the workspace. Check that you entered the complete current key.
The server copy has changed. Automatic uploads are paused and your local notes are safe. Restore a separate copy from the server to compare before uploading again.
The encrypted copy exceeds the transfer limit. Use a local backup or check the server capacity limit.
The downloaded copy did not pass verification. Try again; your existing local workspace has not been replaced.
The operation could not finish. Check the server connection and available storage, then try again. Your existing workspace is preserved.
